ground_truth_root_cause: Memory leak introduced in deployment v2.3.1 of payment-service causing memory usage to climb steadily and trigger OOMKilled process restarts.
Faulty release v2.3.1 deployed on auth-service causing invalid token signature validation logic and high rates of HTTP 500 errors.
Upstream database inventory-db connection exhaustion leading to severe request timeouts in downstream cart-service.
Sudden traffic surge on checkout-service exceeding existing replica count and causing CPU saturation and request queuing.
Erroneously toggled feature flag enable_strict_auth on auth-service breaking valid client tokens.
